note: Not shown: Board of Supervisors (no supervisor contest is on the county's November 3, 2026 contest list), Oxnard City Council Districts 1, 2 and 5 and other city council districts, the mayor contests in Moorpark, Ojai and Simi Valley and at-large council seats in Fillmore, Port Hueneme, Santa Paula and Thousand Oaks, Ventura County Board of Education and Community College trustee areas, school boards, water, sanitation, park, harbor, health care and other special districts, congressional and legislative districts, and school, college, water-district and other city measures (Measures A, B, C, D, H and LV). Sheriff, District Attorney, Assessor and other county offices are not on the county's November contest list. There is no countywide measure. The county superintendent contest is taken from the county's August 12, 2026 contest/candidate proof list (the county posts no separate final certified list); its August 17 off-ballot list does not include that contest. Statewide races and the Supreme Court retention are on the California statewide list. Check your official sample ballot for district contests.

measures.title: City of Oxnard Extension of Measure O Sales Tax
measures.summary: Renews the City of Oxnard's existing one-half cent sales tax, which is used for general city services. The ballot question says it would provide about $20,000,000 a year until ended by voters, with oversight, audits and public disclosure of spending, and all funds staying in Oxnard.
measures.yesMeans: Oxnard's existing one-half cent sales tax continues until ended by voters.
measures.noMeans: The existing one-half cent sales tax is not renewed.
